notes: Second fresh real-prompt screening pool for full-answer correct/wrong trajectory selection.
Indices are a deterministic sample from the GSM8K test split, excluding the 2026-06-15 real-prompt screen pool, canonical/Wave-0 fixtures, and sparsification prompt sets.
Carryover prompt 1300_base and backup 860_base from the first screen are intended to be included separately in the next trace wave; this file is only the fresh 40-prompt screening pool.
The fixture-prep greedy completion is intentionally not used for selection; max_new_tokens is kept small because this target spec is only for preparing prompt files and metadata.
Actual screening generations should sample temperature 0.8 fixed-seed trajectories, then select comparable-length correct/wrong pairs before tracing.

candidate_keep_rules: generated token count preferably <= 512, allow <= 768 for rare otherwise-good pairs
choose one correct and one wrong completion per prompt with length ratio preferably <= 1.5 or absolute difference <= 100 tokens
screening_plan.target_prompt_count_after_screening: 8 fresh prompts, to combine with carryover 1300_base and backup 860_base for a 10-prompt trace wave
screening_plan.split_policy_after_tracing: split by prompt into calibration/metric-selection and held-out evaluation sets
